uniques.name: The Barber's Red Gloves
uniques.effect: Open Wounds lasts 6 seconds instead of 4. Its total damage is unchanged.

uniques.name: Pitfighter's Knuckles
uniques.effect: Crushing Blow removes 10% current Life from normal enemies instead of 8%. Boss value remains 0.5%.

uniques.name: Iron Argument
uniques.effect: The first Stagger against each enemy delays its next attack by 350ms. Later Staggers use normal values.

uniques.name: The Last Touch
uniques.effect: Culling an enemy restores 2% maximum Life, at most once per second.

uniques.name: Surgeon's Ledger
uniques.effect: Life on Hit is doubled against wounded enemies and halved against unwounded enemies.

uniques.name: Wardweaver's Hands
uniques.effect: Energy Shield recovery attempted at full shield is stored. The next direct hit consumes it as magic damage, capped at 25% of maximum Energy Shield.

uniques.name: The Hammer's Memory
uniques.effect: Crushing Blow guarantees Stagger with a 1-second target cooldown. Attack rate is reduced by 8%.

uniques.name: Mercy's End
uniques.effect: Culling threshold is 2 points higher against wounded enemies. Low-Life bosses take 35% increased direct-hit damage instead of 25%.

uniques.name: The Twin Reservoir
uniques.effect: May carry both recovery affixes. Both recovery-per-second caps are reduced by 25%.

uniques.name: Hands of the Red Saint
uniques.effect: Open Wounds can stack 3 times, each dealing 20% of its triggering hit over 4 seconds. Maximum Life is reduced by 15%.

uniques.name: Gauntlets of the Falling Gate
uniques.effect: Boss Crushing Blow removes 0.75% current Life. Crushing Blow guarantees Stagger. Attack rate is reduced by 12%.

uniques.name: Empty Hands of Ordran
uniques.effect: Life recovery at full Life restores Energy Shield at 50% effectiveness. Shield recovery at full shield restores Life at 25% effectiveness. Health Regeneration is reduced by 20%.

uniques.name: Grasp of the Unmoved
uniques.effect: Every fifth eligible hit always Staggers. Staggering grants temporary Energy Shield equal to 5% of maximum shield, capped at 20%.
